candidateOccurrences.sourceText: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

candidateOccurrences.nextContext: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.
